about: The decision table. Each case names a snapshot, a principal and a delegation defined below, the profile, surface, tool and resources of one call, its key and its currency answer when it has them, and the decision expected, with the exact sentence for a denial and, for an allow by an exception in the profile's own list (decision 0011, section 9), the exception's name, which the row records. tests/decision_table.rs runs every case and reports every one that fails. To add a policy rule, add cases here first and watch them fail.

lists.name: otto sees the reads and proposals on its surface, and no direct write or destructive tool
a profile whose data lists every classification still lists no direct write or destructive tool
a narrowing delegation narrows the list
an employee sees the reads and proposals its surface serves
a profile that permits only reads lists only reads
a profile that permits only proposals lists only proposals
a profile that lists no classification lists nothing
a surface the caller may not use lists nothing
a profile the snapshot does not hold lists nothing
a surface that does not exist lists nothing
a delegation that did not verify lists nothing
a delegation that did not verify lists nothing where the profile does not require one
the list skips the currency check, so a profile that requires currency still lists its proposals
exception: a profile whose own list names the comment tools lists them, and no other write tool
exception: a profile whose list does not name the comment tools lists neither, though another profile's does
exception: a profile whose data lists write still lists neither comment tool
exception: the list is still narrowed by the delegation
